title: Josiah knows about Max's mixtape and private beach motel

tellings.quote: stuff and Josiah wrote something about your music is being banded together you love your sacred time at the motel

plain: A documentary filmmaker, Ky Dickens, who has made a film about nonspeaking young people said to read minds, tells of one of them, Josiah. She says that Josiah wrote to a man named Max Davis about his music being "banded together", like a mixtape, and his "sacred time at the motel", a private beach motel on the Gulf of Mexico coast. If true, Josiah knew private details he had no ordinary way of knowing.
